care.advisoryBoundary: Supports a gentle daily cleansing and radiance-focused cosmetic routine. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent acne, hyperpigmentation or another condition. Massage onto damp skin, rinse thoroughly and avoid the eye area; patch test, stop if stinging or rash develops, and seek clinical advice for persistent irritation or changing symptoms.

presentation.usage: Massage onto damp skin morning or evening, working into a light lather, then rinse thoroughly, avoiding the eye area. Follow with your usual routine and SPF in the daytime.
